plain_english_revision: This amendment grants permanent residents of Mobile County and Baldwin County a discount on toll fees for using the I-10 bridge or Wallace Tunnel.
candidate_position_supported: The candidate supports providing financial relief to local permanent residents by offering them half-price access to specific infrastructure tolls, specifically the I-10 bridge and Wallace Tunnel.
evidence_quotes: "A permanent resident of Mobile County or Baldwin County shall be eligible for a half price toll pass"
"for usage of the I-10 bridge or the Wallace Tunnel over the Mobile River"
